touches.text: Runs a proof as its own process and writes a validation record (claim, caller, date, method, verdict, evidence, falsifier, horizon).
Hollow runs: proves a proof goes red when the build is removed.

A tooth whose live subject was deleted retires with it, when fixture teeth still cover the behaviour. Akien 2026-11-12, answering Q#87 (ce92eb562cf9 clause 6 read 6890cf7e4053's clause-2 tooth, deleted with the inference_calls table by 98ab0e9db57f): "i am good with retiring that".

CC's memory lives in a private git repo of its own, linked into the place Claude Code looks for it on each box, so every CC instance is the same CC whichever box it runs on. Its distillations (the method, and CC's patterns to avoid) are published in the CC device in cairn; how we got there, and anything of CC's history of Akien, stays in the private repo. WHY: cairn and CairnCommons are public. "How Akien does it" is meant for anybody; Akien himself, and the people around him, are not. A memory starts private; only a distillation crosses, and Akien reviews what crosses.
